steps.title: Configure Application Build and Manifest
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with correct SDK targets, Gradle settings, and declare required internet permissions and launch Activities inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create Modern Dark Theme Custom Drawables
steps.description: Create premium custom UI XML shapes, borders, card backgrounds, and stylish button drawables featuring a professional gold and charcoal color palette.

steps.title: Implement Native Backend API Client
steps.description: Build the HTTP client class to connect with the Cloud Worker API for login, registration, password reset OTP, and booking synchronization over /data.

steps.title: Design the Login, Registration, and Forgot Password XML Screen
steps.description: Design an elegant Dark Modern Theme login layout that enables authentication and incorporates a dedicated forgot password container for email-based OTP verification.

steps.title: Implement Login and Account Authentication Logic
steps.description: Code LoginActivity.java to manage user sessions, coordinate sign-ups, handle secure tokens, and execute forgot password OTP logic natively.

steps.title: Design the Home & Service Selection Screen Layout
steps.description: Design main dashboard interface using XML layouts to catalog premium saloon services alongside modern checklist selectors and a floating pricing calculator panel.

steps.title: Program the Interactive Service Dashboard & Price Calculator
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java to list saloon services, compute prices dynamically in real time, and pass selection details over to the appointment scheduler.

steps.title: Design the Appointment Scheduling Layout Screen
steps.description: Build an intuitive scheduling layout with direct UI widgets for customer details, date picking, interactive slot matrices, and a golden confirmation CTA.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Scheduling and Session Logic
steps.description: Code BookingActivity.java to validate booking data, display dynamic slot selections, and store final requests securely via the cloud-synced endpoint.

steps.title: Design the Bookings History Layout List
steps.description: Create a robust list layout with dynamic card views to let customers browse their booked appointments and check reservation details.

steps.title: Implement cloud-synchronized History Retrievals
steps.description: Write HistoryActivity.java to fetch and format personal booking rosters, parsing responses from the centralized backend server efficiently.

steps.title: Building BarberQ
steps.description: Perform comprehensive gradle assembly checks and ensure strict environment compatibility with Java 8.
